name: Durandal
source:
The Chancellor of Exlattle.

Acting on behalf of the rarely-seen King Charles XXI, he manages the affairs of the nation with a steady hand.

His words may come across as strict, but beneath them lies a heart that genuinely cares for others.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
